status_summary: In early July 2025 DHS was reported to plan cutting about 750 of roughly 1,000 I&A staff; per Nextgov reporting the plan was paused within days and reductions continued more gradually, leaving about 500 employees by late 2025. The FY2027 budget request, reported on 2026-04-03, would fold I&A into a consolidated headquarters office with the Management Directorate and other headquarters offices, with a stated saving of 53 million dollars, and needs congressional approval. An administration official said on 2026-04-10 that the change would not alter I&A's intelligence community membership or ODNI oversight, so the office has been reduced and proposed for consolidation but not eliminated, and no move of functions to the National Operations Center was found.

timeline.event: After reports of a plan to cut about 750 of roughly 1,000 I&A staff (leaving about 275), DHS said component leads had identified non-critical programs and redundant positions.

Reported FY2027 budget request proposed folding I&A with the Management Directorate, the situational awareness office and the Executive Secretary into one headquarters office, with a stated 53 million dollar saving; the report says I&A had about 500 employees after gradual cuts following a paused July 2025 plan.
An administration official said the proposed consolidation would not affect I&A's intelligence community membership or ODNI oversight.

title: Eliminate the Office of Intelligence and Analysis, moving a few functions to the NOC
uncertainties: Staff counts come from news reports quoting unnamed officials and one anonymous administration source; no DHS document with I&A headcount was opened. The DHS Budget in Brief for FY2027 could not be fetched, so the 53 million dollar figure rests on Nextgov reporting republished by Defense One; the CRS analysis (dated 2026-06-09) describes the request as combining the intelligence and situational awareness element with the Office of the Secretary and Executive Management and the Management Directorate, but the part of it read does not give I&A dollar amounts. Reports of House Intelligence Committee consideration of limits on I&A in November 2025 were private and not confirmed. Related DHS headquarters restructuring is covered in c05-01.
